  echo: false
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
#| message: false
```

```{r}
#| message: false
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
    labels = scales::label_dollar(),
    na.value = "grey85"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2020 Median Household Income by Texas County",
    fill = "Median household income",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates, via tidycensus."
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: create-edu-state
#| message: false
#| cache: true

edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c("B15003_001", "B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025"),
  year = 2020,
  summary_var = "B15003_001"
)
```

```{r}
edu_state |>
  filter(variable != "B15003_001") |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarize(
    total_adults = first(summary_est),
    bachelors_or_higher = sum(estimate),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    percent_bachelors_or_higher = 100 * bachelors_or_higher / total_adults
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = fct_reorder(NAME, percent_bachelors_or_higher),
    y = percent_bachelors_or_higher
  )) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = percent_bachelors_or_higher), color = "white") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
    labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1),
    name = "Bachelor's or higher"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Adults with a Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    x = "State",
    y = "Share of adults with a bachelor's degree or higher",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates, via tidycensus."
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
